To: support@solacemattressco.com
Subject: mattress stuff + a question

Hi there,

Hope you're doing well! Sorry for the long email, I know you probably get a million of these, but I wanted to give you the full picture since I've been meaning to write for a couple weeks now and kept putting it off because life has been chaos. We just moved into our new place in Brindlewood back in July, and between unpacking boxes, dealing with the movers who by the way were fantastic, and trying to get my son enrolled in the new school district before the deadline, I honestly forgot we even ordered the Solace Cloudrest Queen mattress until it showed up on August 3rd. The delivery guys, Marcus and Theo I think their names were, were so professional, they even helped carry the old mattress down to the curb for bulk pickup which they definitely didn't have to do, so five stars for that part of the experience for sure.

Anyway we set it up that same night and for the first couple weeks it was honestly amazing, way better than the old spring mattress we had for like nine years, my back pain actually improved. My husband kept saying we should have switched years ago. We also got the Solace pillow bundle at the same time, two of the cooling gel pillows, and those have been great too, no complaints there at all, they've held their shape and the cover hasn't pilled or anything like that.

So here's the actual issue, and I promise I'm getting to the point. Around the three week mark, so roughly August 24th, I started noticing a dip forming right in the center of the mattress, like a shallow bowl shape, maybe an inch and a half deep when I press on it. It's not from the edges, it's specifically in the middle third where my husband and I both tend to sleep since we're not really side-sleepers. I flipped it over per the little care card that came with it, and gave it about five days, but the dip is still there on both sides now, so I don't think rotating fixed anything. We're not overweight or anything, and there's no kids or pets jumping on it, so I'm not sure what would cause this so early. Also, separately, the carrying handle on the side of the mattress, the fabric loop one, has a small tear where it attaches to the seam, maybe two inches long. It's not affecting how we sleep on it, just seems like it shouldn't happen this soon.

Oh, also, totally unrelated, my neighbor across the street ordered a mattress from a different company entirely, I think it was called DreamNest, and hers arrived with the wrong size, a full instead of a queen, so she's been dealing with their return process for weeks, what a nightmare, I'm glad that's not us. And our old spring mattress, the one the delivery guys hauled away, that thing had a broken coil poking through the fabric for the last two years honestly, we just lived with it, so I have a new appreciation for how a good mattress should feel, dip aside.

We did also add the extended protection plan at checkout, the one that's $39 for two years, I believe, and I still have that email confirmation somewhere if you need the order number, it should be on file under my email anyway. I'm not asking for a full refund on the whole mattress, we do like it overall and moving is expensive enough right now, but I would like either a replacement unit sent out or a repair credit toward the sagging issue, whichever is faster, and if there's any way to also address the torn handle in the same visit that would be great so we're not doing this twice. Please let me know what the next steps look like and whether someone needs to come inspect it first or if photos are enough. Thanks so much for reading this whole novel of an email!

Best,
Andrea Kessler
Order #SC-88214
